subtitle: Rhythmic volume modulation that creates pulsing, hypnotic textures. From subtle movement to dramatic oscillations, tremolo adds life to any guitar tone.

introduction.title: What is Tremolo?
introduction.text: Tremolo is a volume modulation effect that creates rhythmic fluctuations in amplitude. An LFO (Low Frequency Oscillator) controls the volume up and down at regular intervals, creating a pulsing or "shimmering" effect that adds movement and texture to your sound.

columns.title: How It Works
columns.text: LFO modulates signal amplitude. Creates rhythmic volume swells. Speed controls LFO frequency. Depth controls modulation amount. Can use various waveform shapes. Usually sine or triangle waves.

columns.title: Musical Applications
columns.text: Surf and rockabilly guitar. Ambient and atmospheric textures. Clean guitar enhancement. Vintage and retro sounds. Rhythmic accompaniment. Experimental sound design.

sections.title: Tremolo vs. Vibrato
sections.subtitle: Common Confusion
sections.warningText: Many vintage Fender amps labeled their tremolo as "vibrato" and their vibrato as "tremolo" - adding to the confusion!

cards.title: Bias Tremolo
cards.description: Found in vintage amplifiers. Modulates the tube bias voltage, creating a warm, organic tremolo with harmonic richness.

fields.label: Found in
fields.value: Fender amps, Supro amps, vintage circuits

cards.title: Optical Tremolo
cards.description: Uses light-dependent resistors (photocells) and bulbs/LEDs. Smooth, musical modulation with soft attack.

fields.label: Examples
fields.value: Vox amps, many boutique pedals, vintage designs

cards.title: Digital Tremolo
cards.description: Modern processors offer precise control, tap tempo, and multiple waveform shapes for creative possibilities.

fields.label: Examples
fields.value: Boss TR-2, Strymon Flint, many modern pedals

cards.title: Harmonic Tremolo
cards.description: Splits signal into high and low frequencies, modulating them alternately for a more complex, 3D effect.

cards.title: Fender Amp Tremolo
cards.description: The tremolo circuit built into vintage Fender amplifiers set the standard for guitar tremolo. Warm, musical modulation that defined surf and rockabilly.

sections.title: Tremolo Settings Guide
sections.warningText: Tremolo works best when it serves the music. Match the tremolo speed to musical subdivisions (quarter notes, eighth notes, etc.) and use it to enhance the rhythm, not fight against it.
